svg.title: Mockup 12: the sound desk (the plan's sound model, D16)
svg.text: 12 · Sound: six fixed categories, cues per event with their own level and sounds, a library, and a budget per zone

g.text: At most 3 sounds a minute and 20 an hour per zone; one at a time
Urgent always passes and still counts. Limits are event settings.
WHAT EACH ZONE LETS THROUGH NOW
Six, fixed. Events add cues, never categories.
Seeded from the 25 legacy cues; the event adds its own. Each cue: its own level, cooldown and sounds. Several sounds are picked at random, never the same twice running.
Showing 9 of 26 cues. A cue's level multiplies its category's; the voice line plays right after the sound and counts once in the budget. Uploaded voice lines only: no text to speech.
Any sound can go to any cue.
⚠ over 10 s: long sounds tire a room
At most 30 s and 1 MiB each; a warning over 10 s.
The default pack is CC0, with a credits file.
Every decision, with its reason code
calm: something new does not play
